# Komboe

> Komboe is an open-source, zero-knowledge password manager. The master password stays on the device. There is no backdoor and no admin password reset.

## Pages
- [Zero-knowledge password manager](https://komboe.com/): Komboe is an open-source, zero-knowledge password manager. One account, no backdoor, no admin password reset.
- [Features](https://komboe.com/features.html): Every Komboe feature, with links to other products that offer the same idea.
- [Security and zero-knowledge](https://komboe.com/security.html): How Komboe keeps your vault zero-knowledge: on-device encryption, no backdoor and no admin password reset.
- [Pricing](https://komboe.com/pricing.html): Komboe plans for individuals, families and businesses. The free tier is available now.
- [Downloads](https://komboe.com/downloads.html): Download Komboe for phone, desktop, browser, the web, the command line and a self-hosted server.
- [Developers](https://komboe.com/developers.html): Komboe developer resources: source, self-hosting, command line, the assistant and security disclosure.
- [Log in](https://komboe.com/login.html): Sign in to Komboe from the home page. One account for every Komboe app.
- [Sign up](https://komboe.com/signup.html): Create your Komboe account with your email and master password.
- [Privacy Policy (draft)](https://komboe.com/privacy.html): Draft Komboe privacy policy: what data we collect, why, your rights, and how your vault stays encrypted. Pending legal review.
- [Terms of Service (draft)](https://komboe.com/terms.html): Draft Komboe terms of service for the hosted password manager. Pending legal review.
